pass.title: The Troubled Pass
pass.description: Blackstone and Dunmere depend on this road. Goblins hold the narrows and a rockfall blocks the western wheel track. The threats are there whether you take our seal or not.

timber.title: A Load for Six Men
timber.description: Bring a whole trunk to Blackstone's timber yard. The sawyers need sound beams, not a sack of splinters.

bargain.title: The Baron's Bargain
bargain.description: Break the rival Orc tollhold on the ridge. The baron offers 15 coin and written noninterference with taking payment from Dunmere. His guards will stand aside; Dunmere and its neighbors have made no such promise.
